summary: Tested Auto Indent Generation Weight-Based Grouping Logic Fix. All 19 tests passed. The fix correctly extracts and normalizes weights from variant names (e.g., '500+ gm', '500 gm', '500gm' all → '500g') and groups products by product_id + normalized_weight instead of variant_name. This prevents duplicate line items for the same product with different variant name formats.
